title: CoherentModuleFiniteTypeLocalCover
statement: Let X be a scheme, F an X-module, and (U i) an open cover of X. If every restriction F|Ui is coherent, then F is of finite type.

source.place: Definitions 01BV (coherent), 01B5 (finite type), and Lemma 01B6 (pullback preserves finite type); verified at the official Stacks tag pages

proof.text: Coherence implies finite type by Definition 01BV. Apply Mathlib SheafOfModules.IsFiniteType.exists_localGeneratorsData to each restricted module to obtain finite local generating families on opens of each cover member.

For each such open V of U i, its image in X is an open and V.toScheme is canonically isomorphic to that image scheme. Compose Mathlib Scheme.Modules.overEquiv with restriction along this isomorphism. The resulting equivalence identifies the restricted module with F.over of the image and identifies the structure modules. Use GeneratingSections.map and ofEpi to transport the generating family; its index set, hence its finiteness, is preserved.

Index the image opens and their transported generators by the dependent pairs of a cover member and one of its generating neighbourhoods. At a point choose a cover member using hU, then a generating neighbourhood using its CoversTop property. The point lies in its image. Intersect that image with an arbitrary test open to verify the covering sieve. Assemble this cover and the finite generators into F.LocalGeneratorsData and apply IsFiniteType.mk.

proof_origin.place: Definitions 01BV and 01B5; direct locality argument formalized by M2 using Mathlib open-site equivalences and finite generating families (official tag pages verified).

lean.statement: theorem coherent_module_finite_type_local_cover (X : Scheme.{u}) (F : X.Modules) (I : Type u) (U : I → X.Opens) (hU : ⨆ i, U i = ⊤) (hF : ∀ (i : I), RingedSpace.IsCoherent (U i).toScheme.toRingedSpace ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (U i).ι).obj F)) : F.IsFiniteType
